summary: Calm 3D Iznik tile edge-matching puzzle with a kiln firing step, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Kiln adımlı sakin bir 3D İznik çinisi kenar eşleştirme bulmacası, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: 30 levels in 3 chapters: rotate tiles, then swap them, then fixed and double-sided tiles; boards grow from 3x3 to 6x6
v2: coaching happens inside the board, with a one-line tip over the first wrong tile and no tutorial wall
v2: the kiln is a craft step; fire inside the heat gauge's glaze band for a matte, glossy or master finish kept on the panel
v2: the daily board is an excavation board on odd days, with weathered tiles that restore on their first matched edge
v2: live star meter, a master's gallery of all 30 panels with craft notes, and a built-in solver that solves every level
Puzzle-core tests under Node with no dependencies: node tests/core.test.mjs passes 358 of 358 checks

social.headline: Rotate, swap and flip Iznik tiles until every motif connects, then fire the panel · İznik çinilerini çevir, desenleri birleştir, panoyu fırında pişir

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README, index.html, tests/ and docs/assets.md; no field is generated from a guess
